item.text:
The report now documents seventeen reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F17: `syncFollower` can send a `TRUNC` across an epoch boundary**. [LearnerHandler.syncFollower](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/LearnerHandler.java:858) compares only numeric zxids. With a leader committed zxid of `5` in epoch 0 and a follower zxid of `0x100000005` in epoch 1, it queued `TRUNC(0x5)` and `needSnap` remained false, despite the code’s own comment in `queueCommittedProposals` that a learner cannot truncate across epochs.

Observed:

```
need snap: false
queued TRUNC zxid: 0x5
AssertionError: syncFollower queued a cross-epoch TRUNC instead of a snapshot
```

Reproduction: [CrossEpochTruncRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/cross_epoch_trunc/org/apache/zookeeper/server/quorum/CrossEpochTruncRepro.java).

I also ran a focused recovery/election test set (`EmptiedSnapshotRecoveryTest`, `DuplicateLocalSessionUpgradeTest`, `FLERestartTest`, `FLEPredicateTest`, snapshot restore/admin tests, and related tests); all passed. The raw log is retained at `executions/4637440e5b1a48d8aef60391fd85f0c1/stdout.txt`.

The other sixteen findings remain documented; all reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`, and the captured source remains unmodified.
